message: 初版入库：214 条双语对照

after.zh: DearMe 把「想要的生活」拆成看得见的心愿、推得动的计划，和一天一天被你认真过掉的记录。没有催促，没有归零，没有失败。
after.en: DearMe turns the life you want into wishes you can see, plans you can move, and days you actually live. No nagging, no resets, no failures.

after.zh: 数据只留在你的手机里
它和别的 App 不一样的地方

after.en: Not a task manager. A companion.

after.zh: 效率工具让你完成它，陪伴让你想起自己。DearMe 的每一条规则，都在回答同一个问题：怎么让「想变好」这件事，不再变成新的压力。
after.en: Productivity tools want you to finish them. A companion helps you remember yourself. Every rule in DearMe answers one question: how do we keep wanting to be better from turning into more pressure?

after.zh: 一天最多一条提醒。连续几天没打开，它会安静下来，第七天才轻轻问一句「最近还好吗」。没有红点，没有感叹号。
after.en: One reminder a day at most. If you disappear for a few days it goes quiet, and on the seventh day gently asks how you are. No red badges, no exclamation marks.

after.zh: 心愿、里程碑、存下的每一笔钱、打过的每一次卡，都连在同一条时间线上。你随时能翻回去，看见自己是怎么走到这里的。
after.en: Wishes, milestones, every yuan saved, every check-in — all on one timeline. Scroll back any time and see how you got here.

after.zh: 没有账号，没有服务器，没有云端备份。照片不申请相册权限，所有内容只写在这台手机的本地沙盒里。
after.en: No account, no server, no cloud. Photos never ask for library access. Everything lives in the local sandbox of this one phone.

after.zh: 想要的 → 做着的 → 做到的。这不是三个列表，是一件事的三个阶段。
after.en: Wanted → doing → done. Not three lists — three stages of one thing.

after.zh: 物质、体验、成长、关系、自我关怀、愿景。存钱的心愿看金额台阶，做项目的心愿看里程碑权重，旅行的心愿只等一个日期。
after.en: Material, experience, growth, relationship, self-care, vision. Saving wishes track amount steps; project wishes track weighted milestones; trips just wait for a date.

after.zh: 单次、每日、每周、每月、每年。到点生成今天这一格，可以补记，可以跳过，可以「先放一放」。跳过不算失败，也不会进分母。
after.en: Once, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly. Each day makes one cell: backfill it, skip it, or set it down for a while. Skipping is not failure and never counts against you.

after.zh: 今天想说的话，最多三张照片。可以顺手插一枚小胶囊，标注这条记录里的人、物、地点——以后就能顺着它找回来。
after.en: A line about today, up to three photos, and little capsules marking the people, things and places in it — so you can find your way back later.
A star map of your own

after.zh: 把在意的人、物、地方一颗颗挂上去。记录得越多，星星越亮；它们之间连成的线，就是你生活真正的形状。
after.en: Hang the people, things and places you care about into the sky. The more you record, the brighter they glow — and the lines between them draw the real shape of your life.
Make a wish. Then walk it

after.zh: 写下想要的东西，选一个类型，可选地填上金额、期望日期、几个里程碑。
after.en: Write down what you want, pick a type, optionally add an amount, a date, a few milestones.

after.zh: 把它变成能做的事：每周存一笔、每月走一步、每天做一次。计划和心愿会互相回写进度。
after.en: Turn it into something doable: save weekly, step monthly, do it daily. Wish and plan write progress back to each other.

after.zh: 今天这一格亮了，就留一张照片或一句话。错过也没关系，七天内可以补记。
after.en: When today's cell lights up, leave a photo or a line. Missed it? You have seven days to backfill.

after.zh: 点「我做到了」，会有一页只属于那件事的纪念。收下它，或者，再许一个。
after.en: Tap “I did it” and get a memorial page for that one thing. Keep it — or make another wish.
Task systems want you to finish them.
— RiverDriven, the only person behind DearMe

after.zh: 它起源于一个问题：为什么那些「想对自己好一点」的念头，最后都变成了又一个没完成的清单？
after.en: It started with a question: why do all those intentions to be kinder to yourself end up as one more unfinished list?

after.zh: iOS 17 起 · 数据全部留在本地 · 免费下载
下面每一个模块都已经在真机上跑起来了。我们尽量说清楚细节——因为温柔这件事，常常藏在很具体的地方。
after.en: Every module below already runs on a real device. We try to be specific — because gentleness usually hides in very concrete places.
Six kinds of wishes, six ways to count

after.zh: 物质、体验、成长、关系、自我关怀、愿景——选择类型之后，专属字段会跟着展开：要存多少钱、什么时候去、做到哪一步算实现。
after.en: Material, experience, growth, relationship, self-care, vision — pick a type and its own fields open up: how much to save, when to go, what counts as done.

after.zh: 金额型心愿有三档台阶：加油、努力、夯爆了。
after.en: Saving wishes have three steps: keep going, push harder, nearly there.

after.zh: 里程碑按权重加权，改一个档位，总进度会重新算。
after.en: Milestones are weighted; change a weight and the total recalculates.

after.zh: 只有「我做到了」能结束一个心愿，而且不拦你——条件不够时只给一行温柔的提示。
after.en: Only “I did it” ends a wish, and it never blocks you — if something’s missing it just leaves a gentle line.

after.zh: 期望时间 · 明年夏天
已完成 2 个 · 最近一次 11 月 2 日
计划只有一件事要做：告诉你今天该干什么。打开 App，先看到的是「今天」——不是三十条待办的海洋。
after.en: A plan only has one job: tell you what today looks like. Open the app and you see today — not an ocean of thirty todos.

after.zh: 五档频次：单次、每日、每周、每月、每年；短月与闰年都有兜底。
after.en: Five rhythms: once, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly — short months and leap years handled.

after.zh: 单次型也有常驻「做到啦」，不用等提醒。
after.en: Even one-off plans have a permanent “Done it” button — no waiting for a reminder.

after.zh: 措辞里没有失败：只有「先放一放」和「放下了」。跳过不进分母，不算你欠。
after.en: The words never say failure — only “set it down for now”. Skips never count against you.

after.zh: 错过也能补记 · 最近 7 天
打卡之后的那一层，才是最重要的：那天的文字、那天的照片、那天你到底感觉怎么样。点热力图上任意一格，它就会展开成一张「一天的记录卡」。
after.en: The layer after checking in is the point: that day’s words, that day’s photo, how that day actually felt. Tap any cell on the heatmap and it opens into a day card.

after.zh: 完成率只算「做到 ÷（做到 + 过期）」，跳过永远不进分母。
after.en: Completion is done ÷ (done + expired). Skips never enter the denominator.

after.zh: 中断之后不显示「0 天」，只显示累计，或者「新的第 1 天」。
after.en: After a break it never shows “0 days” — only your total, or “a new day one”.

after.zh: 撤销有 30 秒缓冲；改历史记录会二次确认。
after.en: Undo gives you 30 seconds; editing an older day asks once more.

after.zh: 今天在回家的车上读完了，窗外是橘子色的天。
after.en: Finished it on the ride home. The sky outside was tangerine.

after.zh: 把人、物、地方写进句子里
after.en: Write people, things and places into the sentence

after.zh: 「今天和 ⟦妈咪⟧ 在 ⟦海边⟧ 吃了 ⟦那家面⟧。」——那些小胶囊就长在正文里，像小时候贴在本子上的贴纸。以后翻记录，看到的不只是文字，还有那时的人和地方。
after.en: “Today I had noodles with ⟦Mum⟧ by the ⟦sea⟧.” Those capsules live inside the sentence, like stickers in a childhood notebook. Later, you see not just words but who and where you were.

after.zh: 一条日志最多三张照片，选图不申请相册权限。
after.en: Up to three photos per entry; picking never asks for library access.

after.zh: 选完可以取消，取消后沙盒里零残留。
after.en: You can cancel after picking — and nothing is left behind.

after.zh: 人 / 物 / 地三个分组，按你最近常用的顺序排。
after.en: Three groups — people, things, places — ordered by what you used most recently.

after.zh: 2026 年 11 月 18 日 · 星期二
今天和👩 妈咪在📍 海边吃了🍜 那家面，她还记得我小时候不吃葱。
after.en: Today I had noodles with 👩 Mum by the 📍 sea. She still remembers I hated scallions.

after.zh: 你在意的每一个人、每一件东西、每一个地方，都是星图上的一颗星。点一下加号，它就在同一屏里亮起来。记录得越多，星越亮，相关的人与物之间也会连出线。
after.en: Every person, thing and place you care about is a star. Tap plus and it lights up on the same screen. The more you record, the brighter it glows — and lines appear between the ones that meet.

after.zh: 新加的星是虚线的、暗的；挂上第一件事才真正亮起来。
after.en: A new star is dim and dashed; it only truly lights up once something hangs on it.

after.zh: 改名一处改，全局生效；抹掉一颗星，记录还在，4 秒内可撤销。
after.en: Rename once and it changes everywhere; remove a star and its records stay, undoable for 4 seconds.

after.zh: 复盘页会说「关于「妈咪」的 12 件事」——那是你和她真正发生过的。
after.en: The review page says “12 things about Mum” — things that actually happened.

after.zh: 白天你可以用纸面长卷，一条条往下读；夜里想换一种心情，右上角一按，整页变成深蓝黑的霓虹玻璃，横向一张张翻过去。翻页有齿轮声，翻到底会「叮叮叮」。
after.en: By day, page down a paper-like scroll. At night, one tap in the corner turns it into deep-blue neon glass you flip through sideways. Pages click like gears; hitting the end goes ding-ding-ding.

after.zh: 两种视图共用同一份数据，不写假数据、不新建表。
after.en: Both views share one dataset — no fake data, no second table.

after.zh: 你选的那一种会被记住，下次打开还是它。
after.en: Your choice is remembered next time you open it.

after.zh: 开启系统的「减弱动效」后，所有卡片直接落到终态。
after.en: With Reduce Motion on, every card lands straight in its final state.

after.zh: 今天什么都没做，也很好。
after.en: Did nothing today. That was fine too.
Gentleness isn’t a tone. It’s a rule.

after.zh: 中断之后显示累计，而不是 0 天。
after.en: After a break it shows your total, never “0 days”.

after.zh: 提醒一天最多一条，句号结尾。
after.en: One reminder per day at most, ending with a period.

after.zh: 先「放一放」，再「放下」，随时能回来。
after.en: Set it down first, then let it go — and come back any time.

after.zh: 不给你二选一的焦虑，也不替你宣布结果。
after.en: No either-or anxiety, and no announcing your outcome for you.

after.zh: 看完这些，试试真的用它
iOS 17 起 · 数据全部留在本地 · 无账号
after.en: iOS 17+ · all data local · no account

after.zh: 一个人，和一个不想再催你的 App
after.en: One person, and an app that stopped nagging

after.zh: DearMe 是从一张纸上的三个问题开始的：
after.en: DearMe started with three questions on a piece of paper:

after.zh:
我到底想要什么？
我为它做过什么？
我有没有对自己好一点？
after.en:
What do I actually want?
What have I done about it?
Have I been kind to myself?

after.zh: 我试过很多清单类 App，它们都很厉害，也很擅长让我感到自己又欠了点什么。
after.en: I tried many list apps. They were powerful, and very good at making me feel I owed something again.

after.zh: 所以我决定反过来做：不是把生活塞进一个系统，而是做一个能陪着你的东西。它记得你许过的愿，也记得你没做到的那些天——并且从不因此给你打分。
after.en: So I built it the other way round: not squeezing life into a system, but making something that stays with you. It remembers the wishes you made, and the days you didn’t manage — and never grades you for them.

after.zh: 于是有了心愿和计划这条主线：想要的，拆成做着的；做着的，一天一天留下痕迹；做到的，值得一页只属于它的纪念。中间那些断掉的日子、想放弃的瞬间，也被认真对待——先「放一放」，而不是「删除」。
after.en: That became the spine of wishes and plans: what you want gets split into what you do; what you do leaves a trace, day by day; what you finish earns a page of its own. The broken stretches and the moments you wanted to quit are treated seriously too — set it down for now, never delete.

after.zh: 再后来，记录长出了自己的样子：一句今天想说的话，最多三张照片，几个小胶囊标出当时的人、物、地方；还有一张会变亮的星图，把你真正在意的那些连起来。
after.en: Later the journal grew its own shape: one line about today, up to three photos, little capsules marking who and what and where; plus a star map that brightens, connecting the things you truly care about.

after.zh: 这中间没有团队，没有排期会议，没有增长指标。只有一个开发者、一份写得很细的产品文档，和一条一条被真机验证过的规则。
after.en: No team, no planning meetings, no growth targets. One developer, one very detailed product spec, and rules verified one by one on a real device.

after.zh: 先写下产品定位：从「记录型」走向「陪伴型」。这句话后来成了所有取舍的尺子。
after.en: First the positioning: from recording to accompanying. That sentence became the ruler for every trade-off.
Wishes and plans close the loop

after.zh: 六类心愿、五类计划、五档频次、双向回写、达成纪念页——一个心愿能完整走完从许下到纪念的全流程。
after.en: Six wish types, five plan types, five rhythms, two-way write-back, memorial pages — a wish can now go from made to remembered.
Journal and star map take shape

after.zh: 霓虹横滑卡、一天的记录卡、人货场锚点、会变亮的星图、正文里的胶囊——App 从「打卡工具」变成了一个可以存放生活的地方。
after.en: Neon card carousel, day cards, people/things/places anchors, a star map that brightens, capsules inside sentences — the app stopped being a check-in tool and became a place to keep a life.

after.zh: 全量单元测试跑通，真机走查一条条过，文案逐句收口。上架之后，这里会换成真正的下载链接。
after.en: Full test suite green, device walkthroughs one by one, copy tightened sentence by sentence. Once live, this becomes a real download link.

after.zh: lobus 是我给自己做的这些小东西留的一块地方。一个球、一条轨道、一个小小的场域——它装不下宏大的野心，但装得下那些不太实用、又真的很重要的念头。
after.en: lobus is the small place I keep for the things I make. A sphere, an orbit, a little field — too small for grand ambitions, just big enough for the impractical thoughts that actually matter.

after.zh: DearMe 是 lobus 的第一件：关于怎么对自己好一点。后面还会有别的。
after.en: DearMe is lobus No.01: about being kinder to yourself. There will be more.

after.zh: 联系邮箱为占位地址，替换成你的真实邮箱即可。
after.en: The contact email is a placeholder — swap in your real address.

after.zh: 如果这听起来像你需要的
after.en: If this sounds like what you need

after.zh: 给自己一个开始，就从写下第一个心愿起。
after.en: Start by writing down your first wish.

after.zh: 一个把「想要的生活」变成心愿、计划和一天天记录的 App。由 RiverDriven 一个人做出来，lobus 出品。
after.en: An app that turns the life you want into wishes, plans and daily traces. Made by one person, RiverDriven. A lobus work.

after.zh: 本站为演示站点：下载链接与邮箱订阅为占位，上架后替换。
after.en: Demo site: download link and email signup are placeholders, to be replaced at launch.

after.zh: 还在 App Store 审核的路上。留个邮箱，上线那天第一个告诉你。
after.en: Still on its way through App Store review. Leave an email and you’ll be the first to know.

after.zh: 演示站点：邮箱不会被保存，也不会真的发送。
after.en: Demo site: the email is not stored or sent.
